surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the alternating pulsing of bismuth tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionate) (Bi(thd)3) and ferrocene (Fe(Cp)2) combined with ozone (O3). The precursor pulse ratio Bi/Fe was optimized to 2/1. The exact chemical equations for the surface reactions are not explicitly provided in the text.
evidence: The precursor pulse ratio Bi/Fe was optimized to 2/1 using a pulse time of 2 s and a purge time of 20s with an average deposition rate of 0.02 nm/supercycle to obtain the required film stoichiometry (1Bi:1Fe). Also ALD window was identified between 220-250ºC, see Figure S1. The Bi(thd) source was maintained at 168ºC and the Fe(Cp)2 source at 90ºC.
